Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese spy linked to the Nvidia CEO scandal, is reportedly in Beijing with Chinese security officials’ knowledge.
Her whereabouts had been unclear since Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair and Nvidia’s board launched an investigation into espionage allegations. 
Alice Huang founded Megaspeed, a major Nvidia partner that has imported more than $4.6 billion in Nvidia products and rents advanced chips to companies including Alibaba. 
Beijing denies she is a spy, while the controversy has raised questions about Jensen Huang’s future at Nvidia.
Source: Bloomberg
